title.zh: 荷兰可持续能源生产与气候转型激励计划（SDE++）

anchors.locator: Netherlands Enterprise Agency (RVO) — Stimulation of sustainable energy production and climate transition (SDE++) (overview)
anchors.exact_quote: The Sustainable Energy Production and Climate Transition Incentive Scheme (SDE++) provides subsidies to companies and non-profit organisations that generate renewable energy or reduce CO2 emissions on a large scale.
